correctness.rationale: Kummer identifies valuations with carries of the overlapping binary strings for n+2n. Merging states (1,0),(0,1) gives exact 3x3 weighted transfer matrix M(z), initial state (1,0,0) and a necessary final zero-input carry column (1,1,z). Independent symbolic inversion reproduced (1+t)(1-tz)/(1-(1+z)t+(z-z^2-1)t^2+(z+z^2)t^3); numerator and denominator are coprime over Q(z). The first carry forces a second, excluding valuation 1; no-carry words are Fibonacci. Dominant eigenvalue derivatives lambda'(1)=1 and lambda''(1)=4/3 give slopes 1/2 and 11/12, with primitive transfer matrix yielding a genuine CLT. Independent direct digit-sum checks r<=14 corroborated exact zero count and absent valuation 1; finite data do not prove the CLT.
